input_requirement: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.

ambiguities.fragment: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
ambiguities.explanation: The logical connective 'and' lacks defined operator precedence, yielding two mutually exclusive interpretations: either System-A adds System-B to its own downstream systems (implying a unidirectional connection), or it adds System-B to the downstream systems of another system with which it is connected (implying a bidirectional connection).
possible_interpretations: System-A adds System-B to its own downstream systems, creating a unidirectional connection.
System-A adds System-B to the downstream systems of another system with which it is connected, creating a bidirectional connection.

ambiguities.fragment: and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow
ambiguities.explanation: The logical connective 'and' lacks defined operator precedence, yielding two mutually exclusive interpretations: either System-A allows System-C to subscribe to its own Reporting flow (implying a unidirectional connection), or it allows System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow of another system with which it is connected (implying a bidirectional connection).
possible_interpretations: System-A allows System-C to subscribe to its own Reporting flow, creating a unidirectional connection.
System-A allows System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow of another system with which it is connected, creating a bidirectional connection.
